diagnosis.summary: Nightly run 96b46359 (2026-10-01) failed at ingest because upstream added a new column, `coupon_code`, to orders.csv. The column isn't in the raw.orders contract. All 7 contract columns are present, the file has a normal 440 rows and the other landing files are clean. Proposed fix: set ingest to ignore the extra `coupon_code` column for orders, then rerun.

root_cause.explanation: orders.csv for 2026-10-01 has an extra column, coupon_code, that isn't in the raw.orders contract. No contract columns are missing. Ingest's header check rejects any mismatch, so the step failed. The data is otherwise fine: 440 rows, normal values, no parse problems.

evidence.claim: The ingest step failed with a schema mismatch on raw.orders: missing [], unexpected ['coupon_code']
The landing orders file has all contract columns plus coupon_code, 440 rows and no parse problems
440 rows is in the normal range for orders partitions (412-534), so this is not a partial export
The other tables' landing files for this day match their contracts
The runbook maps an unexpected-only column to 'new column added upstream', fixed with ignore_extra_columns
Ingest config is at defaults, so no earlier change explains the failure

alternatives_considered: Column rename: ruled out because no contract column is missing
Partial or corrupt export needing redelivery: ruled out because the row count is normal, the file ends with a newline and there are no parse problems
Bad dbt model deploy: ruled out because the failure happened at ingest, before transform
Escalate to upstream to add coupon_code to the contract: not needed for pipeline health; adding it can be a separate request

proposal.rationale: Upstream added a new non-contract column 'coupon_code' to orders.csv (unexpected only, no missing columns). All 7 contract columns are present with normal values and the row count (440) is in the usual range; other landing files are clean. Per runbook, new non-contract columns are adapted in ingest by ignoring them.

applied: ingest now ignores upstream columns ['coupon_code'] on raw.orders
